entries: If there is something you are after, please tell us. Otherwise, allow us to carry on our way.
你若有所图，请直说。否则，就让我们继续赶路。
I have bad experiences with creatures that have more than two arms.
对于手臂超过两条的生物，我有过糟糕的经历。
So far from home. And yet, not so far at all.
离家如此之远。却又全然不算远。
We cannot share. There is a quest of great importance, and we require the memories. All of them.
我们不能分享。有一项极其重要的使命，我们需要那些记忆。全部。
So noble. I truly did not expect to be so entertained. One does not get much company in the void.
真是高尚。我着实没料到会这么有趣。在虚空里，可没什么人能作陪。
The ruse is up then? No more games?
把戏到此为止了？不再玩下去了？
I had no intention of sharing of course, but you knew that already, did you not?
我当然从没打算分享，可你们早就知道，不是吗？
It took strength for you to reach this place alive. Let us test that strength once more.
能活着抵达这里，你们靠的是实力。让我们再考验一次那份实力。
I wouldn't have shared such an astounding gem with a foul thing like you anyways.
反正我也不会把这样一颗惊人的宝石，分享给你这种腌臜东西。
This place does not belong to you, but to a friend of mine.
这地方不属于你，而属于我的一位朋友。
Careful. This being is immensely dangerous. I can sense it.
小心。这东西危险至极。我感觉得到。
Come, share them with me. There is no reason to be afraid.
来吧，把它们分享给我。没有理由害怕。
Fear and caution are not the same.
恐惧与谨慎不是一回事。
I have a healthy dose of both, thank you.
这两样我都有恰当的分量，谢谢。
I saw what happened to him. One must be careful in this place. Your mere presence can attract... unpleasant entities.
我看见了他的下场。在这地方必须小心。你们光是存在，就可能引来……不快的存在。
I know many places, but I choose to stay here. This place brings so many... gifts.
我知道许多地方，但我选择留在这里。这地方带来如此多的……礼物。
I have made this my home, and you are intruders. Still, I am not unkind.
我把这里当作我的家，而你们是闯入者。不过，我并不刻薄。
One does not idly come to this place. I imagine that you seek the same thing that drew me here.
没有人会无缘无故来到这里。我猜，你们寻找的，正是把我引来此地的同一样东西。
The memories trapped within this gem radiated into the void. I could feel them...
困在这颗宝石里的记忆，向虚空散发着波动。我能感觉到它们……
Prepare friends. Peace was never an option with this one.
准备战斗，朋友们。跟这一个，从来谈不成和平。
Let us get to the point. What do you want with us?
我们直说吧。你想从我们这里得到什么？
I've got a bad feeling about this.
我对此有种不祥的预感。
